- `public Vector3 this[int column] { get; set; }` - Column 0 to 2 as a vector (GDScript's basis[i] and GodotSharp's Basis[i]; Basis[0] is the X axis).

- `public Basis(Vector3 axis, float angle)` - A rotation of angle radians about a normalized axis.
- `public Basis(Quaternion quaternion)` - The rotation a quaternion stands for.
- `public static Basis Identity { get; }`

### Callable

`public readonly struct Callable : IEquatable<Callable>` - Something that can be called: a method on an object, a delegate, or either with arguments bound (Godot's Callable).

- `public Callable(GodotObject target, StringName method)` - A method of an object, by name.
- `public static Callable From(Delegate d)`
- `public static Callable From(Action action)`
- `public static Callable From<T0>(Action<T0> action)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, T1>(Action<T0, T1> action)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, T1, T2>(Action<T0, T1, T2> action)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, T1, T2, T3>(Action<T0, T1, T2, T3> action)`
- `public static Callable From<TResult>(Func<TResult> func)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, TResult>(Func<T0, TResult> func)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, T1, TResult>(Func<T0, T1, TResult> func)`
- `public static Callable From<T0, T1, T2, TResult>(Func<T0, T1, T2, TResult> func)`
- `public GodotObject? Target { get; }` - The object the method is called on, if any.
- `public StringName? Method { get; }` - The method name, if this is a method callable.
- `public Delegate? Delegate { get; }` - The delegate, if this is a delegate callable.
- `public bool IsNull { get; }`
- `public bool IsCustom { get; }`
- `public bool IsValid()` - True when there is something to call: a live target, or a delegate.
- `public Variant Call(params Variant[] args)` - Calls it.
- `public Variant Callv(Collections.Array arguments)` - Calls it with the arguments in an array.
- `public void CallDeferred(params Variant[] args)` - Calls it when the current tick pass ends (Godot's call_deferred).
- `public Error Rpc(params Variant[] args)` - Calls the node method this callable names as an RPC on every other peer (GDScript's func.rpc(args)).
- `public Error RpcId(long peerId, params Variant[] args)` - Calls the node method this callable names as an RPC on one peer (GDScript's func.rpc_id(peer, args)).
- `public Callable Bind(params Variant[] args)` - A callable that passes args after whatever it is called with.
- `public Callable Unbind(int argCount)` - A callable that drops the last argCount arguments it is called with.
- `public Callable Bindv(Collections.Array arguments)` - Like Bind with the arguments in an array.
- `public static Callable Create(Variant variant, StringName method)` - A callable for a method of an object given as a value (GDScript's Callable.create); null if the value is not an object.

### FabricSpace

`public static class FabricSpace` - Godot space (metres, +Y up, -Z forward, right-handed) to Aver space (centimetres, +Z up, +X forward, left-handed).

- `public const float CmPerMetre = 100f` - Centimetres in a metre: the unit change on positions and sizes.
- `public static Vec3 ToAverPosition(Vector3 p)` - A position in metres to Aver centimetres.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverPosition(Vec3 p)` - A position in Aver centimetres to Godot metres.
- `public static Vec3 ToAverDirection(Vector3 d)` - A direction or any unitless vector: the axis map without the unit change.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverDirection(Vec3 d)`
- `public static Vec3 ToAverAngular(Vector3 w)` - An angular velocity, torque or any rotation axis scaled by an angle: the map of the quaternion's vector part, (x, y, z) to (z, -x, -y).
- `public static Vector3 FromAverAngular(Vec3 w)`
- `public static float ToAverLength(float metres)` - A length in metres to centimetres (no axis).
- `public static float FromAverLength(float cm)`
- `public static Quat ToAverRotation(Quaternion q)` - A rotation quaternion.
- `public static Quaternion FromAverRotation(Quat q)`
- `public static Vec3 ToAverScale(Vector3 s)` - A scale: dimensionless, so it permutes with the axes only.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverScale(Vec3 s)`
- `public static void ToAver(Transform3D t, out Vec3 position, out Quat rotation, out Vec3 scale)` - A Godot transform as the position, rotation and scale an Aver entity stores.
- `public static void ToAverMatrix12(Transform3D t, float[] dest, int offset = 0)` - A Godot affine transform as the engine's instance matrix: 12 floats, the row-vector world matrix with its 4th column dropped (three basis rows, then the translation in centimetres), written at offset.
- `public static void ToAverTangent(Vector3 normal, Vector3 tangent, float handedness, float[] dest, int offset)` - The tangent the engine stores for a vertex whose Godot normal and tangent (xyz and handedness) are given (G4 R1's contract): the unit tangent made orthogonal to the normal, and w = +1/-1 so that cross(N, T) * w points along increasing v.
- `public static Transform3D FromAver(Vec3 position, Quat rotation, Vec3 scale)` - An Aver entity's position, rotation and scale as a Godot transform.

`public class FileAccess : RefCounted` - A file open for reading, writing or both (Godot's FileAccess).

- `public long GetPosition()`
- `public long GetLength()`
- `public void Seek(long position)`
- `public void SeekEnd(long position = 0)` - Moves to position bytes before the end (0, the default, is the end itself).

- `public string GetLine()` - One line without its line break (a "\r" before the "\n" is dropped).
- `public string[] GetCsvLine(string delim = ",")` - One line of comma-separated values (or another delim): a value in quotes may hold the delimiter and line breaks, and "" in quotes is a quote.
- `public string GetAsText(bool skipCr = false)` - The whole file as text (UTF-8), from the start; the position is left where it was.
- `public string GetPascalString()` - A string written by StorePascalString: a 32-bit length, then that many UTF-8 bytes.
- `public Variant GetVar(bool allowObjects = false)` - A value written by StoreVar.

- `public bool Store16(long value)`

### Geometry2D

`public static class Geometry2D` - Godot's Geometry2D: polygon and segment helpers in the plane.

- `public static bool IsPolygonClockwise(Vector2[] polygon)` - True when the points run clockwise in Godot's 2D (y down), which is a negative shoelace sum in y up.
- `public static bool IsPointInPolygon(Vector2 point, Vector2[] polygon)`
- `public static int[] TriangulatePolygon(Vector2[] polygon)` - The triangles of a simple polygon by ear clipping, as indices into it; empty when it is degenerate.
- `public static Vector2[] ConvexHull(Vector2[] points)` - The convex hull of the points, counter-clockwise in y up, closed (the first point repeated at the end as Godot does).
- `public static Vector2 GetClosestPointToSegment(Vector2 point, Vector2 s1, Vector2 s2)`
- `public static Variant SegmentIntersectsSegment(Vector2 fromA, Vector2 toA, Vector2 fromB, Vector2 toB)` - The point where the segments cross, or nil.
- `public static Variant LineIntersectsLine(Vector2 fromA, Vector2 dirA, Vector2 fromB, Vector2 dirB)` - The point where two lines (a point and a direction each) cross, or nil.

### Geometry3D

`public static class Geometry3D` - Godot's Geometry3D: intersection tests, planes of boxes, capsules and cylinders, and clipping.

- `public static Variant RayIntersectsTriangle(Vector3 from, Vector3 dir, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c)` - The point where a ray meets the triangle (a, b, c), or nil.
- `public static Variant SegmentIntersectsTriangle(Vector3 from, Vector3 to, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c)` - The point where the segment from→to meets the triangle, or nil.
- `public static Vector3[] SegmentIntersectsSphere(Vector3 from, Vector3 to, Vector3 spherePosition, float sphereRadius)` - [point, normal] where the segment first enters the sphere, or an empty array.
- `public static Vector3[] SegmentIntersectsCylinder(Vector3 from, Vector3 to, float height, float radius)` - [point, normal] where the segment first meets a cylinder along Y, centred on the origin, or an empty array.
- `public static Vector3[] SegmentIntersectsConvex(Vector3 from, Vector3 to, Collections.Array<Plane> planes)` - [point, normal] where the segment first enters the convex shape bounded by the planes (normals point outward), or an empty array.
- `public static Vector3 GetClosestPointToSegment(Vector3 point, Vector3 s1, Vector3 s2)` - The nearest point of the segment s1→s2 to the point.
- `public static Vector3 GetClosestPointToSegmentUncapped(Vector3 point, Vector3 s1, Vector3 s2)` - The nearest point of the infinite line through s1 and s2 to the point.
- `public static Vector3[] GetClosestPointsBetweenSegments(Vector3 p1, Vector3 p2, Vector3 q1, Vector3 q2)` - The nearest pair of points between two segments: [on p1→p2, on q1→q2].
- `public static Vector3[] ClipPolygon(Vector3[] points, Plane plane)` - The polygon cut by the plane, keeping what is behind it (Godot's inside).
- `public static Collections.Array<Plane> BuildBoxPlanes(Vector3 extents)` - The six planes of a box with these half extents, outward normals.
- `public static Collections.Array<Plane> BuildCylinderPlanes(float radius, float height, int sides, Vector3.Axis axis = Vector3.Axis.Z)` - The planes of a cylinder: sides around its axis and a cap at each end.
- `public static Collections.Array<Plane> BuildCapsulePlanes(float radius, float height, int sides, int lats, Vector3.Axis axis = Vector3.Axis.Z)` - The planes of a capsule: sides around its axis and lats latitude rings on each cap.
- `public static Vector3[] ComputeConvexMeshPoints(Collections.Array<Plane> planes)` - The corner points of the convex shape the planes bound.

### GeometryInstance3D

`public class GeometryInstance3D : VisualInstance3D`

- `public void SetInstanceShaderParameter(StringName name, Variant value)`
- `public Variant GetInstanceShaderParameter(StringName name)`
- `public float VisibilityRangeBegin { get; set; }` - Metres from the camera at which the instance appears (0: no lower bound).
- `public float VisibilityRangeEnd { get; set; }` - Metres from the camera at which the instance disappears (0: no upper bound).
- `public float VisibilityRangeBeginMargin { get; set; }` - The distance past the begin threshold the instance must cross to change state (hysteresis).
- `public float VisibilityRangeEndMargin { get; set; }`
- `public VisibilityRangeFadeModeEnum VisibilityRangeFadeMode { get; set; }`
- `public GeometryInstance3D? VisibilityParent { get; set; }` - Kept, not applied: a visibility dependency is not faded in.
- `public Material? MaterialOverride { get; set; }` - Replaces the mesh's own material; its asset name reaches the entity's mesh renderer.
- `public Material? MaterialOverlay { get; set; }`
- `public ShadowCastingSetting CastShadow { get; set; }` - Off casts no shadow into the sun's cascade and global-illumination shadow maps (the ray-traced sun shadow still sees the mesh); ShadowsOnly draws nothing for a camera and keeps the mesh for shadows, global illumination and reflections; DoubleSided casts as On does.
- `public float Transparency { get; set; }`
- `public float LodBias { get; set; }` - A multiplier on how long the mesh keeps its finer levels of detail (1: the default; 0 forces the coarsest).
- `public GIModeEnum GIMode { get; set; }` - Static is Aver's ordinary mesh (part of the voxel GI bake); Dynamic and Disabled keep the mesh out of the bake as a mover is, and a Disabled one still takes part in the lighting like any mesh (Aver has no baked lightmaps).
- `public float GILightmapTexelScale { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied: there is no lightmap to size.
- `public LightmapScaleEnum GILightmapScale { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied: there is no lightmap to size.
- `public float ExtraCullMargin { get; set; }` - Metres the box the frustum and occlusion tests use grows by, so a vertex shader that moves geometry is not culled early.
- `public bool IgnoreOcclusionCulling { get; set; }` - Opts the instance out of the occlusion test (the editor's Play; the shipped runtime has no occlusion culling).
- `public Aabb CustomAabb { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied: the engine uses the mesh's own bounds.

- `public static bool IsInstanceValid(GodotObject? instance)` - True when instance is not null and has not been freed.
- `public bool IsQueuedForDeletion()` - True once the object is queued to be freed at the end of the frame.
- `public virtual void Free()` - Frees the object now.
- `public void Dispose()`

- `public virtual bool IsClass(string @class)` - True when the object is, or derives from, the class of that name (native Godot class names and script class names).
- `public override string ToString()`
- `public void Notification(int what, bool reversed = false)` - Sends a notification to the script's _Notification.
- `public virtual void _Notification(int what)` - Overridden by scripts to receive notifications.
- `public void Set(StringName property, Variant value)` - Sets a property, a field or an exported variable by its Godot name.
- `public Variant Get(StringName property)` - Reads a property, a field or an exported variable by its Godot name; nil when there is none.
- `public void SetDeferred(StringName property, Variant value)` - Sets a property at the end of the current tick pass.
- `public Variant Call(StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls a method by its Godot name (or its C# name).
- `public Variant CallDeferred(StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls a method when the current tick pass ends.
- `public bool HasMethod(StringName method)`
- `public string[] GetExportedPropertyNames()` - The names of the properties and fields scripts can reach by name (exported or declared by a script class).
- `public void NotifyPropertyListChanged()` - Tells Godot's inspector to read the property list again; nothing shows one in a running game.
- `public void SetMeta(StringName name, Variant value)`
- `public Variant GetMeta(StringName name, Variant @default = default)`
- `public bool HasMeta(StringName name)`
- `public void RemoveMeta(StringName name)`
- `public StringName[] GetMetaList()`
- `public bool HasSignal(StringName signal)`

- `public bool IsBlockingSignals()`

- `public bool IsConnected(StringName signal, Callable callable)`

- `public Callable[] GetSignalConnections(StringName signal)` - The callables connected to a signal, in connection order.

### Input

`public static class Input` - Keyboard, mouse, gamepad and action state with Godot's names (Godot's Input singleton).

- `public static bool IsActionPressed(StringName action, bool exactMatch = false)`
- `public static bool IsActionJustPressed(StringName action, bool exactMatch = false)`
- `public static bool IsActionJustReleased(StringName action, bool exactMatch = false)`

- `public static float GetActionRawStrength(StringName action, bool exactMatch = false)` - The strength with no dead zone applied: a stick pushed less far than the dead zone still reads its value here.
- `public static float GetAxis(StringName negativeAction, StringName positiveAction)` - Positive strength minus negative strength: -1 to 1.
- `public static Vector2 GetVector(StringName negativeX, StringName positiveX, StringName negativeY, StringName positiveY, float deadzone = -1f)` - A direction from four actions, with a circular dead zone (a negative deadzone averages the four actions' own).
- `public static void ActionPress(StringName action, float strength = 1f)` - Presses an action as if an event had (Godot's action_press).
- `public static void ActionRelease(StringName action)`
- `public static bool IsAnythingPressed()`
- `public static void FlushBufferedEvents()` - Godot delivers accumulated input at once here; Aver hands every event to the scripts as it arrives, so nothing is waiting.
- `public static bool IsKeyPressed(Key keycode)`
- `public static bool IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key keycode)`
- `public static bool IsKeyLabelPressed(Key keycode)`
- `public static bool IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton button)`
- `public static bool IsJoyButtonPressed(int device, JoyButton button)`
- `public static float GetJoyAxis(int device, JoyAxis axis)` - An axis reading, -1 to 1 (a stick pushed down reads positive, as in Godot).
- `public static MouseButtonMask GetMouseButtonMask()`
- `public static Vector2 GetLastMouseVelocity()` - The pointer's velocity in pixels per second, from the last motion event.
- `public static Vector2 GetLastMouseScreenVelocity()`
- `public static GodotObject Singleton { get; }` - The object that carries Input's signals: Input.Singleton.Connect("joy_connection_changed", ...).
- `public static event Action<long, bool>? JoyConnectionChanged` - Raised when a gamepad is plugged in or removed (Godot's joy_connection_changed): the device number and whether it is now connected.
- `public static Collections.Array<int> GetConnectedJoypads()` - The connected gamepads' device numbers.
- `public static string GetJoyName(int device)` - The device's name ("" for a pad that is not connected).
- `public static string GetJoyGuid(int device)` - Approximated: the engine does not read the device's GUID, so this is empty.
- `public static bool IsJoyKnown(int device)` - Whether the engine maps the device to the standard layout: every connected pad is read through one.
- `public static Collections.Dictionary GetJoyInfo(int device)` - Approximated: the vendor, product and mapping details are not read, so the dictionary holds only the pad's name.
- `public static void StartJoyVibration(int device, float weakMagnitude, float strongMagnitude, float duration = 0f)` - Rumbles a pad: the weak (high-frequency) and strong motors, 0 to 1, for duration seconds (0 until stopped).
- `public static void StopJoyVibration(int device)`
- `public static Vector2 GetJoyVibrationStrength(int device)` - The last rumble asked of the pad: weak and strong magnitude (Godot's get_joy_vibration_strength).
- `public static float GetJoyVibrationDuration(int device)` - The seconds the last rumble was asked to run (0: until stopped).
- `public static Vector3 GetAccelerometer()` - Approximated: zero.
- `public static Vector3 GetGravity()`
- `public static Vector3 GetGyroscope()`
- `public static Vector3 GetMagnetometer()`
- `public static bool EmulateTouchFromMouse { get; set; }` - Whether the left mouse button acts as a finger (Godot's emulate_touch_from_mouse).
- `public static bool EmulateMouseFromTouch { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied (approximated): on Windows a touch already arrives as a mouse event, and SDL's touch-to-mouse is left at its default.
- `public static bool UseAccumulatedInput { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied: the engine delivers each input event as it comes (it never merges motion into one per frame).
- `public static void SetDefaultCursorShape(CursorShape shape = CursorShape.Arrow)` - The shape the pointer shows while it is over the window.
- `public static CursorShape GetCurrentCursorShape()`
- `public static void SetCustomMouseCursor(Resource? image, CursorShape shape = CursorShape.Arrow, Vector2 hotspot = default)` - Replaces a cursor shape with an image.
- `public static void SetCustomMouseCursorPixels(byte[]? rgba, int width, int height, CursorShape shape = CursorShape.Arrow, Vector2 hotspot = default)` - Replaces a cursor shape with w x h RGBA bytes (straight alpha, top row first, each side 1 to 256), the hotspot inside the image; null puts the system shape back.
- `public static void WarpMouse(Vector2 position)` - Moves the pointer to a position in viewport pixels at the next frame.
- `public static void VibrateHandheld(int durationMs = 500, float amplitude = -1f)` - Approximated: Aver has no handheld haptics, so this does nothing; the first call says so in the log.
- `public static MouseModeEnum MouseMode { get; set; }` - Whether the pointer is shown, hidden, captured or confined to the game window.
- `public static void ParseInputEvent(InputEvent @event)` - Feeds an event to the game as if it had come from a device (Godot's parse_input_event): input and action state change, and the event goes down the tree to _Input and _UnhandledInput.

### MultiplayerSpawner

`public class MultiplayerSpawner : Node` - Replicates nodes added below spawn_path from the spawner's multiplayer authority to the other peers (Godot's MultiplayerSpawner).

- `public event Action<Node> Spawned` - Emitted on a remote peer when the authority's spawn arrived and the node was added.
- `public event Action<Node> Despawned` - Emitted on a remote peer just before a despawned node is freed.
- `public NodePath SpawnPath { get; set; }` - The node the spawned scenes live under, relative to the spawner.
- `public uint SpawnLimit { get; set; }` - The most nodes this spawner replicates at once; 0 means no limit.
- `public Callable SpawnFunction { get; set; }` - Makes the node for Spawn from its data, on every peer.
- `public string[] SpawnableScenes { get; set; }` - The scenes that replicate when added under spawn_path (the scene file paths; the position in this list is what travels on the wire).

- `public void ClearSpawnableScenes()`
- `public int GetSpawnableSceneCount()`
- `public string GetSpawnableScene(int index)`
- `public Node? Spawn(Variant data = default)` - Calls spawn_function with the data, adds the node it returns under spawn_path and replicates it.
- `public override void _EnterTree()`
- `public override void _ExitTree()`

### MultiplayerSynchronizer

`public class MultiplayerSynchronizer : Node` - Copies properties from the node's multiplayer authority to the other peers, every sync interval (Always), when they change (OnChange), and with a spawn (Godot's MultiplayerSynchronizer).

- `public event Action Synchronized`
- `public event Action DeltaSynchronized`
- `public event Action<long> VisibilityChanged`

- `public double DeltaInterval { get; set; }` - Seconds between looks at the OnChange properties; 0 looks on every frame.

- `public VisibilityUpdateModeEnum VisibilityUpdateMode { get; set; }`

- `public void RemoveVisibilityFilter(Callable filter)`

### Node

`public class Node : GodotObject` - A node of the scene tree (Godot's Node).

- `public MultiplayerApi? Multiplayer { get; }` - The multiplayer API of the branch this node is in: the one a SceneTree.SetMultiplayer call named for an ancestor path, else the tree's default.
- `public int GetMultiplayerAuthority()` - The peer that owns this node: it may call authority-mode RPCs and sends the node's synchronizer state.
- `public void SetMultiplayerAuthority(int id, bool recursive = true)` - Gives the node (and, by default, every node below it) to a peer.
- `public bool IsMultiplayerAuthority()` - True when this peer owns the node (always true offline).
- `public Error Rpc(StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls an [Rpc] method on every other peer (and here too when it is call_local).
- `public Error RpcId(long peerId, StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls an [Rpc] method on one peer (negative: on everyone but that peer).
- `public void RpcConfig(StringName method, Variant config)` - Sets (or, with nil, removes) one method's RPC settings: a dictionary with rpc_mode, transfer_mode, call_local and channel (Godot's rpc_config).
- `public Variant GetRpcConfig()` - Every RPC method of this node as a dictionary of settings, by name (Godot's get_rpc_config).
- `public virtual void _EnterTree()` - Called when the node enters the tree, parents before children.
- `public virtual void _ExitTree()` - Called when the node leaves the tree, children before parents.
- `public virtual void _Ready()` - Called once when the node and all its children have entered the tree: children first.
- `public virtual void _OnreadyVars()` - A converted script's @onready variables, set just before _Ready as Godot does: every class of the script's chain sets its own (base first, each override calls base), whatever its _ready does.
- `public virtual void _Process(double delta)` - Called every frame.
- `public virtual void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)` - Called on every fixed physics step.
- `public virtual void _Input(InputEvent @event)` - Called for each input event, before the UI and before _UnhandledInput.
- `public virtual void _UnhandledInput(InputEvent @event)` - Called for input events nothing before it handled (call GetViewport().SetInputAsHandled() to stop an event).
- `public virtual void _UnhandledKeyInput(InputEvent @event)`

- `public static bool HasEnvironment(string variable)`

- `public static void UnsetEnvironment(string variable)`
- `public static int GetProcessorCount()` - The number of logical processors.
- `public static string GetProcessorName()` - The CPU's model name (the registry on Windows, /proc/cpuinfo on Linux), or "" when the system does not say.
- `public static string GetKeycodeString(Key code)` - The name of a key, with its modifiers ("Ctrl+Shift+A", "Space", "Kp 5"), as Godot writes it.
- `public static Key FindKeycodeFromString(string @string)` - The key a name stands for (the inverse of GetKeycodeString, letter case ignored); None when none does.
- `public static bool IsKeycodeUnicode(long code)` - True when the code is a character key (a Unicode code point), not one of the named special keys.
- `public static Error MoveToTrash(string path)` - Moves a file or folder (an operating-system path) to the recycle bin.
- `public static ulong GetStaticMemoryUsage()` - The bytes of managed memory in use: Godot's "static" memory is the engine's own allocations, and the managed heap is what this runtime holds.
- `public static ulong GetStaticMemoryPeakUsage()` - The most GetStaticMemoryUsage has reported so far.
- `public static string GetUserDataDir()` - The folder user:// names: the player's writable folder for this project, created on first use.
- `public static string GetDataDir()` - The folder the platform keeps per-user application data in (Godot's get_data_dir).
- `public static string GetConfigDir()` - The folder the platform keeps per-user configuration in (Godot's get_config_dir).
- `public static string GetCacheDir()` - The folder the platform keeps per-user caches in (Godot's get_cache_dir).
- `public static string GetExecutablePath()`
- `public static int GetProcessId()`
- `public static ulong GetThreadCallerId()` - The caller's thread id.
- `public static string GetLocale()` - The user's locale in Godot's spelling ("en_US"), "en" when the system gives none.
- `public static string GetLocaleLanguage()` - The language part of GetLocale ("en").
- `public static bool IsUserfsPersistent()` - Whether user:// survives a restart: it is a folder on disk, so it does.
- `public static void DelayMsec(int msec)` - Blocks the calling thread for the milliseconds.
- `public static void DelayUsec(int usec)` - Blocks the calling thread for the microseconds (rounded up to whole milliseconds).
- `public static string[] GetCmdlineArgs()` - Every argument the program was started with, after its own name (Godot's get_cmdline_args).
- `public static string[] GetCmdlineUserArgs()` - The arguments after a lone "--": the ones meant for the game, as Godot's get_cmdline_user_args gives them.
- `public static Error ShellOpen(string uri)` - Opens a web address, a file or a folder in the program the system associates with it (Godot's shell_open).

### PackedArrays

`public static class PackedArrays` - The methods of GDScript's packed arrays (PackedByteArray, PackedInt32Array, PackedStringArray, PackedVector3Array ...) for the arrays Aver.Fabric uses for them.

- `public static T[] FromArray<T>(Collections.Array array)` - An Array where a packed array is wanted (Expression.parse(text, names), a function returning PackedStringArray): each element converted, as Godot does.
- `public static Collections.Array ToArray<T>(T[] packed)` - A packed array where an Array is wanted.
- `public static T[] Append<T>(T[] array, T value)` - The array with value added at the end (push_back, append).
- `public static T[] AppendArray<T>(T[] array, T[] other)` - The array with all of other added at the end (append_array).
- `public static T[] Insert<T>(T[] array, long at, T value)` - The array with value inserted before at (insert); an index outside the array leaves it unchanged.
- `public static T[] RemoveAt<T>(T[] array, long at)` - The array without the element at at (remove_at); an index outside the array leaves it unchanged.
- `public static T[] Resize<T>(T[] array, long size)` - The array cut or padded with default values to size elements (resize); a negative size gives an empty array.
- `public static void Fill<T>(T[] array, T value)` - Sets every element to value in place (fill).
- `public static void Sort<T>(T[] array)` - Sorts the numbers or strings in ascending order, in place (sort); strings compare by code unit, as Godot compares them.
- `public static void Reverse<T>(T[] array)` - Reverses the order in place (reverse).
- `public static long Find<T>(T[] array, T value, long from = 0)` - The index of the first element equal to value at or after from, or -1 (find).
- `public static long Count<T>(T[] array, T value)` - How many elements equal value (count).
- `public static T[] Slice<T>(T[] array, long begin, long end = int.MaxValue)` - A copy of the elements from begin up to, not including, end (slice); a negative index counts from the end.
- `public static T[] Duplicate<T>(T[] array)` - A copy of the array (duplicate).

- `public static void EnvironmentSetSsilQuality(EnvironmentSsilQuality quality, bool halfSize, float adaptiveTarget, int blurPasses, float fadeoutFrom, float fadeoutTo)` - Approximated, kept as set: Aver has no screen-space indirect lighting; its GI is ray traced.

- `public static void GiSetUseHalfResolution(bool halfResolution)` - Approximated, kept as set: Aver's GI resolution follows its GI quality level (RENDER.GI), not this switch.
- `public static void EnvironmentGlowSetUseBicubicUpscale(bool enable)` - Approximated, kept as set: the glow upscale filter is Aver's own.
- `public static void EnvironmentSetVolumetricFogFilterActive(bool active)` - Approximated, kept as set: Aver's volumetric fog is filtered as the renderer decides.
- `public static void EnvironmentSetVolumetricFogVolumeSize(int size, int depth)` - Approximated, kept as set: Aver's volumetric fog grid is sized by the renderer.
- `public static ulong GetRenderingInfo(RenderingInfo info)` - What the last frame submitted (P18): objects, triangles and draw calls from the engine's statistics, which are counted only once something has asked (the first call returns 0, the next frame's numbers follow).
- `public static void DecalsSetFilter(DecalFilter filter)` - Approximated, kept as set: decals and light projectors are sampled with the engine's material sampler.
- `public static void LightProjectorsSetFilter(LightProjectorFilter filter)` - Approximated, kept as set: a light's cookie image is sampled with the engine's own filter.
- `public static void DirectionalShadowAtlasSetSize(int size, bool is16Bits)` - Approximated, kept as set: the sun's cascade size (RENDER.SHADOWRES) is read when the renderer starts, so a size set while the game runs changes nothing that is drawn.

- `public static void SetDefaultClearColor(Color color)` - Approximated, kept as set: a level's background is its sky, which the converter writes from the Environment (or the project's default clear colour) at conversion; a colour set here later does not repaint it.

`public static class RenderMapping` - Godot's rendering numbers to Aver's.

- `public static float Scale3D(float godotScale)` - scaling_3d_scale clamped to Godot's 0.25 to 2.
- `public static float FsrSharpness(float godot)` - fsr_sharpness: 0 is the sharpest and the sharpness halves with every 1.0; Aver's sharpness is 0 to 1 with 1 the sharpest.
- `public static int AverSrPreset(float scale)` - The AverSR preset (1 quality, 2 balanced, 3 performance; 0 none) nearest an FSR-style scale below 1.
- `public static float LodThresholdPixels(float godot)` - mesh_lod_threshold is the screen-space error in pixels, as RENDER.LODTHRESHOLD (0 to 64).
- `public static float LodBiasStops(float multiplier)` - GeometryInstance3D.lod_bias is a multiplier (1: the default settings); CMeshRenderer.lodBias is in stops, the base-2 logarithm, -8 for 0 and below.
- `public static int ShadowResolution(int atlasSize, int cascades)` - One cascade's edge (RENDER.SHADOWRES) from Godot's directional shadow atlas size: half the atlas with two or more splits, all of it for one, clamped to 512 to 4096 and snapped down to a power of two.
- `public static float ShadowFilterWidth(int quality)` - soft_shadow_filter_quality (0 hard ...
- `public static int CascadeCount(int godotMode)` - directional_shadow_mode (0 orthogonal, 1 two splits, 2 four splits) as a cascade count.
- `public static float FitSplitLambda(int cascades, ReadOnlySpan<float> godotFractions, float nearCm, float farCm)` - The least-squares split lambda for Aver's slice formula against Godot's split fractions (independent fractions of the shadow range): -1 when there is nothing to fit.
- `public static (int Cascades, float Lambda, float DistanceCm) FitSunShadow(int godotMode, float split1, float split2, float split3, float maxDistanceM, float cameraNearM)` - A sun's shadow settings as RENDER.SHADOW* values: cascades, split lambda (-1: the engine's), distance in cm (0: automatic).
- `public static int GlowBlend(int godotMode)` - glow_blend_mode (0 additive, 1 screen, 2 soft light, 3 replace, 4 mix): the POSTVOLUME key glowblend has the same numbers.
- `public const float EngineUnitLux = 100000f / 3f` - One engine radiance unit in lux (the 100000 lux sun is 3.0 of them).
- `public static float PhysicalShadingEnergy(LightClass kind, float lightEnergy, float intensity, float exposureNormalization)` - The shading energy Godot uses with physical units: light_energy times the intensity (lux, or lumens) times 1 (directional), 1/(4 pi) (omni) or 1/pi (spot) times the camera's exposure normalization.
- `public static float PhysicalAverIntensity(LightClass kind, float lightEnergy, float intensity, float exposureNormalization)` - The same as an Aver CLight intensity (lux for the sun, candela at 1 m for a local light).
- `public static float PhysicalExposureNormalization(float aperture, float shutterSpeed, float sensitivity)` - CameraAttributesPhysical: 1 / (1.2 aperture^2 shutter_speed (100 / ISO)), the shutter speed in 1/s.
- `public static float PracticalExposureNormalization(float sensitivity)` - CameraAttributesPractical: the sensitivity over 3072007 (the physical default at ISO 100).
- `public static (float R, float G, float B) TemperatureTint(float kelvin)` - Light3D.light_temperature as a LINEAR tint (the brightest channel 1): Godot multiplies it with the light colour in linear light when physical units are on.

### Tween

`public class Tween : RefCounted` - Animates properties, calls and intervals in sequence or in parallel (Godot's Tween).

- `public event Action Finished`
- `public event Action<long> StepFinished`
- `public event Action<long> LoopFinished`
- `public Tween()`
- `public PropertyTweener TweenProperty(GodotObject @object, NodePath property, Variant finalVal, double duration)` - Animates a property of an object from its value when the step starts to finalVal.
- `public IntervalTweener TweenInterval(double time)` - Waits time seconds.
- `public CallbackTweener TweenCallback(Callable callback)` - Calls a callable when its step is reached.
- `public MethodTweener TweenMethod(Callable method, Variant from, Variant to, double duration)` - Calls a method every frame with a value interpolated from from to to.
- `public SubtweenTweener TweenSubtween(Tween subtween)` - Runs another tween as one step of this one: it plays for its own length and this tween waits for it.
- `public Tween SetParallel(bool parallel = true)` - Makes every tweener from now on run alongside the previous one (or, with false, one after the other).
- `public Tween Parallel()` - Makes only the next tweener run alongside the previous one.
- `public Tween Chain()` - Makes the next tweener start after the previous step (undoes SetParallel for one tweener).
- `public Tween SetLoops(int loops = 0)` - How many times the tween plays; 0 is forever.
- `public int GetLoopsLeft()`
- `public Tween SetSpeedScale(float speed)`
- `public Tween SetTrans(TransitionType trans)` - The transition tweeners use unless they name their own (default Linear).
- `public Tween SetEase(EaseType ease)` - The ease tweeners use unless they name their own (default InOut).
- `public Tween SetProcessMode(TweenProcessMode mode)`
- `public Tween SetPauseMode(TweenPauseMode mode)`
- `public Tween SetIgnoreTimeScale(bool ignore = true)`
- `public Tween BindNode(Node node)` - Binds the tween to a node: it stops when the node is freed, waits while the node is out of the tree, and (by default) pauses when the node does.
- `public void Play()` - Starts or resumes the tween.
- `public void Pause()`
- `public void Stop()` - Stops the tween and rewinds it to its beginning; Play starts it again.
- `public void Kill()` - Ends the tween now; it cannot be used again.
- `public bool IsRunning()`
- `public bool IsValid()`
- `public double GetTotalElapsedTime()`
- `public bool CustomStep(double delta)` - Steps the tween by hand (for a tween that was stopped, or one driven from a script).
- `public static Variant InterpolateValue(Variant initial, Variant delta, double elapsed, double duration, TransitionType trans, EaseType ease)` - The value elapsed seconds into a duration-second move from initial by delta along the curve (Godot's Tween.interpolate_value).

### Viewport

`public class Viewport : Node` - A rendering/input area (Godot's Viewport).

- `public event Action SizeChanged` - Raised when the viewport's size changes (Godot's size_changed): a window the player resizes, or a script setting Size.
- `public virtual Vector2I Size { get; set; }` - The size in pixels.
- `public virtual ViewportTexture? GetTexture()` - The picture this viewport draws as a texture.
- `public virtual Rect2 GetVisibleRect()` - The area Controls are laid out in: the viewport's size (the window's stretched content size for the root window).
- `public Control? GuiGetFocusOwner()` - The control that has keyboard focus, or null.
- `public void GuiReleaseFocus()` - Takes keyboard focus away from whichever control has it.
- `public Control? GuiGetHoveredControl()` - The control the pointer is over (the deepest one that takes mouse events), or null.
- `public bool GuiIsDragging()`
- `public Variant GuiGetDragData()`
- `public bool GuiIsDragSuccessful()` - Whether the last drag ended with a control taking the data.
- `public void GuiCancelDrag()`
- `public World3D World3D { get; set; }` - The 3D world of this viewport: its physics space.
- `public World3D FindWorld3D()` - The 3D world this viewport draws and simulates in (Godot's find_world_3d, which walks up to the viewport that owns one).
- `public virtual Camera3D? GetCamera3D()` - The camera that is drawn (the one made current last).
- `public virtual Vector2 GetMousePosition()` - The pointer in viewport pixels: the engine's reading every frame (the position the UI sees, before any content stretch), else where script-fed events last put it.
- `public void SetInputAsHandled()` - Stops the input event being processed by anything further (Godot's set_input_as_handled).
- `public bool IsInputHandled()`
- `public virtual Msaa Msaa3D { get; set; }` - Anti-aliasing by multisampling.
- `public Msaa Msaa2D { get; set; }` - Stored, not applied: the engine draws no 2D with multisampling.
- `public bool UseTaa { get; set; }` - Temporal anti-aliasing.
- `public ScreenSpaceAAEnum ScreenSpaceAA { get; set; }` - The post-process anti-aliasing mode.
- `public bool UseDebanding { get; set; }` - Dithers the final colour before it is quantised.
- `public bool UseOcclusionCulling { get; set; }` - Occlusion culling of the window's scene.
- `public float MeshLodThreshold { get; set; }` - The screen-space error in pixels above which a mesh drops to a coarser level (Godot's default 1; 0 turns the automatic choice off).
- `public virtual Scaling3DModeEnum Scaling3DMode { get; set; }` - How the 3D scene is scaled to the screen.
- `public virtual float Scaling3DScale { get; set; }` - The scale the 3D scene is drawn at before it is brought to the window's size (0.25 to 2).
- `public float FsrSharpness { get; set; }` - The upscaler's sharpness as Godot spells it (0 sharpest, halving every 1.0).
- `public float TextureMipmapBias { get; set; }` - Stored: the engine's texture sampling is set per material and by RENDER.TEXTUREMIPBIAS when the project starts.
- `public AnisotropicFiltering AnisotropicFilteringLevel { get; set; }` - Stored (RENDER.TEXTUREANISO is read when the renderer starts).
- `public int PositionalShadowAtlasSize { get; set; }` - Stored: the local lights' shadow maps are sized by the renderer.
- `public bool PositionalShadowAtlas16Bits { get; set; }` - Stored.
- `public void SetPositionalShadowAtlasQuadrantSubdiv(int quadrant, PositionalShadowAtlasQuadrantSubdiv subdiv)` - Stored: how many shadows a quadrant of the positional shadow atlas holds.
- `public PositionalShadowAtlasQuadrantSubdiv GetPositionalShadowAtlasQuadrantSubdiv(int quadrant)`
- `public DebugDrawEnum DebugDraw { get; set; }` - Stored: the engine has no per-viewport debug draw modes in the game.
- `public bool UseHdr2D { get; set; }` - Stored: the engine renders 2D in the display format.
- `public bool UseXr { get; set; }` - Stored, inert: XR rendering is not supported (the XR nodes are carriers).
- `public bool HandleInputLocally { get; set; }` - Stored, inert: every viewport's input goes through the one event path (Godot's input routing between nested viewports).
- `public VrsModeEnum VrsMode { get; set; }` - Stored: variable-rate shading is not used.
- `public VrsUpdateModeEnum VrsUpdateMode { get; set; }` - Stored.
- `public Texture2D? VrsTexture { get; set; }` - Stored.

### Window

`public class Window : Viewport` - The window at the top of the tree; its name is "root" (Godot's Window).

- `public Vector2I GetSizeWithDecorations()` - The window's size: the engine's window has no decorations it reports apart.
- `public string Title { get; set; }` - The window's title bar text.
- `public ModeEnum Mode { get; set; }` - The window's mode: windowed, minimized, maximized or fullscreen.
- `public Vector2I Position { get; set; }` - The window's top-left in screen pixels.
- `public bool Borderless { get; set; }` - No frame or title bar.
- `public bool AlwaysOnTop { get; set; }`
- `public bool Unresizable { get; set; }` - The player cannot resize the window.
- `public bool Transparent { get; set; }` - Kept as set (approximated): the engine's window is opaque.
- `public bool Unfocusable { get; set; }` - Kept as set (approximated): the engine's window takes focus as any window does.
- `public bool HasFocus()` - Whether the window has the keyboard focus.
- `public override Vector2 GetMousePosition()`
- `public ContentScaleModeEnum ContentScaleMode { get; set; }` - How the UI follows the window's size: nothing stretches (default), the canvas is drawn scaled (canvas_items), or the picture is rendered at the base size and scaled up (viewport).
- `public ContentScaleAspectEnum ContentScaleAspect { get; set; }` - What happens when the window's shape differs from the base size's.
- `public ContentScaleStretchEnum ContentScaleStretch { get; set; }` - Fractional or integer scaling.
- `public Vector2I ContentScaleSize { get; set; }` - The size the UI is authored at; zero in either axis means none (no stretch).
- `public float ContentScaleFactor { get; set; }` - The extra scale applied on top of the stretch.
- `public override Vector2I Size { get; set; }` - The window's pixel size: the shipped game's, as it published it (the player may have resized the window), else the one a script set, else the project's WINDOW.SIZE.
- `public override Rect2 GetVisibleRect()` - The area Controls are laid out in: the window's pixels divided by the content scale factor, or the base size (letterboxed or grown) when the stretch mode is on.
- `public Rect2 GetContentScreenRect()` - Where the stretched content lands in the window, in window pixels (the letterbox is the rest).
- `public bool IsLetterboxed()`
- `public Vector2 WindowToContent(Vector2 p)` - A point in window pixels (the pointer) in UI space; a point in a letterbox bar comes out outside the visible rectangle.
- `public Vector2 ContentToWindow(Vector2 p)`

### WorkerThreadPool

`public static class WorkerThreadPool` - Runs callables on the pool's worker threads (Godot's WorkerThreadPool).

- `public static long AddTask(Callable action, bool highPriority = false, string description = "")` - Runs action on a worker and returns the task's id.
- `public static bool IsTaskCompleted(long taskId)`
- `public static Error WaitForTaskCompletion(long taskId)` - Waits for the task and forgets it; a task id is good for one wait.
- `public static long GetCallerTaskId()` - The id of the task the calling worker is running; -1 outside a task.
- `public static long AddGroupTask(Callable action, int elements, int tasksNeeded = -1, bool highPriority = false, string description = "")` - Calls action with each index from 0 to elements - 1, spread over the workers, and returns the group's id.
- `public static bool IsGroupTaskCompleted(long groupId)`
- `public static int GetGroupProcessedElementCount(long groupId)` - How many of the group's elements have been called so far.
- `public static void WaitForGroupTaskCompletion(long groupId)` - Waits for every element of the group and forgets the group.
- `public static long GetCallerGroupId()` - The id of the group task the calling worker is running; -1 outside one.
